caption:
Some grief is too heavy to say out loud

Prophet Yaqub said he complains of his anguish and sorrow only to Allah, and that he knows from Allah what others do not know. Your grief can go to Him too, in your own words.

Surah Yusuf 12:86

Send this to someone carrying a quiet grief tonight

#grief #prophetyaqub #quranreels #sabr
